role: Director, Office of Environmental Project Review, Department of the Interior
stance_basis: listed as CC recipient on Section 4(f) determination memo indicating coordination with Department of the Interior, which formally concurred with no objection
summary: Bruce Blanchard, Director of the Office of Environmental Project Review at the Department of the Interior, is listed as a carbon copy recipient on the FHWA's Section 4(f) determination memo dated December 3, 1976. The Department of the Interior, through a separate letter signed by the Deputy Assistant Secretary, formally concurred with the Section 4(f) finding and offered no objection to the project's approval. Blanchard's office was part of the interagency coordination process for this highway reconstruction project.
complaint_summary: Bruce Blanchard is listed as a carbon copy recipient on the FHWA Section 4(f) determination memo, indicating his office was part of the interagency review and coordination process for the Lincoln Highway reconstruction project.
